name: The Food Movement Natural Products Company
old_description: Founded in 2011, The Food Movement Co. has been dedicated to bringing pure, plant-based nutrition to people worldwide. Every product we make is third-party tested and crafted with care — ensuring quality, integrity, and results you can trust.
about:
The Food Movement Natural Products Company was founded in 2011 in Arlington Heights, Illinois. The company began with a mission to deliver pure, plant-based nutrition to a global audience, emphasizing ingredients sourced from the earth and validated by science. No founders are named in public materials, and the ownership structure has not been disclosed.

The company formulates and sells a range of dietary supplements under the Black Earth® brand, including fulvic and humic mineral concentrates, zeolite detox sprays, colloidal silver, magnesium complexes, and a line of organic superfoods such as Irish sea moss, maca, moringa, and plant-based vitamin C. All products are manufactured without synthetic fillers, use vegan capsules, and undergo third‑party laboratory testing for heavy metals and microbiological contamination. The brand reports distribution through more than 1,000 health‑food stores nationwide and a direct‑to‑consumer channel serving over 10,000 customers.

Primary customers include independent health‑food retailers, specialty grocers, and individual consumers seeking clean‑label supplements. The product categories target energy and vitality, daily balance, whole‑body support, and detoxification. The company also offers a subscription program for recurring deliveries.

The Food Movement differentiates itself by combining regenerative organic and biodynamic plant nutrition with rigorous third‑party verification. Its Black Earth® mineral complex supplies over 70 trace minerals, and the company states that sustainable sourcing from ethical farms and eco‑friendly packaging are core to its founding purpose.
